Strings.$ExtensionDesc: Components for generating TTS messages from Central Weather Administration (Taiwan) Open Data.
Strings.EarthquakeBody: At {0}, a magnitude {2:F1} earthquake occurred in {1}. Max intensity {3}.
Strings.TsunamiBodyLifted: Based on the analysis, the tsunami threat has passed, and thus the tsunami warning is lifted.
Strings.TsunamiBodyMessage: The tsunami caused by this earthquake may impact Taiwan. Please stay tuned for further information.
Strings.TsunamiBodyMessageGreen: The tsunami caused by this earthquake does not impact Taiwan.
Strings.TsunamiBodyWarning: The tsunami caused by this earthquake will impact Taiwan, and thus a tsunami warning has been issued. People in coastal areas should be alerted to pay attention to the harm caused by sudden rises of waves.
Strings.TsunamiEarthquakeBody: At {0}, a magnitude {2:F1} earthquake occurred in {1}.
Strings.TsunamiForecast: The following areas are estimated to have a tsunami height of {0}.
Strings.TsunamiObservation: Currently, the tsunami heights observed per area are as follows.
Strings.TsunamiObservationMaxHeight: Currently, the maximum tsunami height observed is {0} meters.
